Opening a saved design/model uses the full preset transition to retire shape jobs and caches, retaining its Extreme setting. Report Opening until the current requested recipe reaches _applyBuild, then report Opened.

harnessCorrections: The scheduling VM now provides performance, required by the existing draw timer.
The native renderer check reads the current view after a scripted builder reopen, avoiding capture of the disposed old canvas.
limits: Native evidence uses controlled blur/focus events in the real editor plus temporary saved JSON designs; it does not claim an exhaustive OS/window-manager focus audit.
Saved exported-model records share _openRecord, but this native pass opens Forge designs.
